story.title: Trump Criticizes Zelenskyy, Suggests Ukraine Needs New Leadership
story.summary: Donald Trump has criticized Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, suggesting that Ukraine should elect a new president. He blamed Zelenskyy for rising US diesel prices and criticized his failure to negotiate a peace deal with Russia. Trump also cautioned Ukraine against targeting Russian oil refineries that supply diesel fuel to the US.

timeline_highlights.title: Israel Commemorates Third Anniversary of October 7 Attacks
timeline_highlights.summary: Israel observed the third anniversary of the October 7 attacks, which resulted in the deaths of 1,200 people and the kidnapping of 251 others. A moment of silence was held at 6:29 AM, the time the attacks began, and various tributes were organized by bereaved families. In Gaza, the aftermath of the conflict continues to affect nearly two million residents, who are living in dire conditions due to the ongoing war.
key_facts: Israel commemorated the third anniversary of the October 7 attacks.
1,200 people were killed and 251 were taken hostage during the attacks.

timeline_highlights.title: Third Knife Attack in Polish Schools Injures Three in a Week
timeline_highlights.summary: A woman injured three people in a school knife attack in Poland, marking the third such incident in less than a week. This attack follows two earlier incidents that resulted in a female caretaker's death and multiple injuries. In response to the violence, Polish police have detained 76 individuals connected to the previous attacks.

related_stories.title: Tragic Capsizing of Migrant Boat off Djibouti Leaves 139 Dead and 84 Missing
related_stories.summary: A migrant boat capsized off the coast of Djibouti, resulting in at least 139 confirmed deaths, including 15 children. The International Organization for Migration reported that 84 individuals remain missing, while 82 survivors, all Ethiopian nationals, have been accounted for. The vessel was reportedly carrying over 300 people en route to Yemen when the incident occurred.

related_stories.title: Trump Announces Energy Ceasefire Between Russia and Ukraine
related_stories.summary: President Donald Trump announced that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an 'energy ceasefire' amid ongoing tensions. However, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy expressed skepticism, stating that this was 'news for me' and indicated that Ukraine would halt strikes on Russian oil refineries only if Russia ceased its attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure. Trump's comments have drawn criticism, particularly regarding his previous remarks about Ukraine's leadership.

related_stories.title: Spanish Police Clear Last Migrant Camp in Ceuta Before Royal Visit
related_stories.summary: Spanish police have dismantled the last migrant beach camp in Ceuta, transporting individuals to reception centers for processing. This action took place ahead of a planned visit by the king. Some migrants have reported allegations of mistreatment by Spanish soldiers during the camp clearance.
